scenarios.name: Launch a command by key tip from the minimized ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the temporary 3D Model command area opens with command key tips
the Hole command displays the key tip "HO"
the visible command key tips narrow to H-prefixed choices
the user clicks Cancel in the Hole properties panel
the temporary command area closes leaving the ribbon minimized to tabs
the user double-clicks the 3D Model tab
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
